_meta.notes: Every visible string of the Legal form lives here (template via bin/build-site.php, legal.js via the #strings data attribute). formVersion is the single source of the form version (not in app.env): bump it whenever fields or validation rules change. limits are mirrored by legal.js; the server re-checks them (Prompt 4).

rejected._note: Per-file messages for the server's reason codes (docs/PAYLOAD.md section 4). {name} file name, {ext} its extension, {max} MB per file, {maxFiles}, {maxTotal} MB in total.
rejected.mime_mismatch: “{name}” isn't a valid {ext} file (its contents don't match its type). Remove it, or save it again in the correct format.
rejected.macro: “{name}” contains macros, which aren't accepted. Save it as a regular .docx/.xlsx without macros.
rejected.encrypted: “{name}” is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
rejected.not_office: “{name}” isn't a valid Word or Excel file. Open it in Word or Excel and save it again as .docx or .xlsx.
rejected.zip_limits: “{name}” is too large or complex once unpacked to be accepted. Save a smaller copy, or save it as PDF.
rejected.nul_bytes: “{name}” isn't a plain text file. Save it again as text (.txt) or CSV, or as PDF.
rejected.too_large: “{name}” is larger than {max} MB. Remove it, or make it smaller.
rejected.too_many: “{name}” is over the limit of {maxFiles} files. Remove it, or combine some files.
rejected.total_too_large: “{name}” takes the files over {maxTotal} MB in total. Remove it, or make some files smaller.
rejected.empty: “{name}” is empty. Remove it, or attach the right file.
rejected.not_allowed: “{name}” isn't an allowed file type. Remove it, or save it as Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, PDF, PNG, JPG or text (.txt).
rejected.upload_failed: “{name}” didn't upload completely. Remove it and attach it again.
rejected.unknown: “{name}” wasn't accepted. Remove it, then submit again.
